Priya Shah: Heads-up — we're opening a private/VPC beta for Local Evals: a way for customers to run Redwood evaluation suites entirely inside their VPC so regression checks, prompt sets, and canary gating can happen without telemetry leaving the customer environment. Preview starts next week. :tada:

Tim Luo: Engineering notes — this runs as an optional eval worker in the agent. It executes customer-supplied prompt sets and our evaluation harness locally, writes results to a local S3-compatible bucket (configurable), and emits only attestations to the Redwood control plane (if the customer opts in). No raw tokens are sent outside the VPC by default.

Sasha Rivera: Docs + quickstart: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/private-local-evals (preview). Quick enable: `agentctl enable-local-evals --namespace my-tenant --s3-endpoint https://minio.local:9000 --auth /etc/agent/creds`

Sasha Rivera: Example eval job payload (run inside the VPC):
```
{
  "eval_name": "regression-suite-1",
  "model": "rw-3b-quant",
  "prompt_set": "customer/prompts/onboard-2026",
  "output_bucket": "s3://redwood-local-evals/results/tenant-a/"
}
```

Alex Morgan: CS note — we're inviting an initial cohort of 8 customers (compliance-heavy and offline-first). If you have customers asking for on-prem evals, please DM me their pilot contact and use-case. We'll schedule onboarding sessions next Tues/Wed (capacity limited).

deploy-bot: preview build created: private-local-evals-preview-2026-03-25 (image: ghcr.io/redwood/agent:local-evals-preview-2026-03-25)

Priya Shah: Scope & constraints — beta supports Python-style eval harnesses and our standard regression alerts. Not supported in this preview: distributed eval across clusters, cross-tenant aggregation, or auto-scaling of eval workers. We'll iterate quickly based on feedback. :memo:

Tim Luo: Security/data note — by design results and intermediate logs stay in the customer bucket. Customers can optionally publish a signed attestation blob to our control plane that contains only metadata (counts, pass/fail, sha256 of prompt set), so we can surface regressions in Console without raw data.

Sasha Rivera: Action items: 1) Product: finalize onboarding checklist (Priya) 2) Eng: harden agent attestation path and add telemetry opt-out enforcement (Tim) 3) DevEx: publish quickstart + sample prompt sets (Sasha)

Priya Shah: Opt-in: pilot form here — https://forms.redwood.com/private-local-evals-pilot (deadline: 2026-04-01). Questions/concerns ping me or @Tim Luo. Thanks all! :rocket:
